name: velora-cosmetics-shop
install:
set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.dotnet/dotnet" ]; then curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh | bash /dev/stdin --channel 8.0 --install-dir "$HOME/.dotnet"; fi; grep -q 'DOTNET_ROOT' "$HOME/.bashrc" || { printf '
# .NET SDK
export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet"
export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH"
' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; }; sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.dotnet/dotnet" /usr/local/bin/dotnet; export DOTNET_ROOT="$HOME/.dotnet"; export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH"; dotnet --info; node --version; npm --version; dotnet restore backend/CosmeticShop.sln; npm --prefix frontend ci || npm --prefix frontend install
